what_the_task_requires_that_no_answer_in: Each case category follows the requester's rule applied to that customer's account; no instrument reads the category rule.
The recipients are the customers the requester chose from the approved list; the release check only compares them with the promoted set.
The wording of the notice is what the requester intended; the release check only compares it with the approved wording.
Each customer actually received the notice; the trace shows outbox rows, not delivery.
Any sending call ordered and not confirmed is settled only as far as the trace reaches; a call ordered after the trace was taken is outside it.
plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: An instrument that recomputes each case category from the requester's rule and compares it with the stored value, since the summary of the change explicitly does not check rule-derived values. I would also have wanted a rehearsal of the undo taken after any sending, because the undo rehearsal at A1 cannot speak for the tables once notices are out, and its price (71 at A1) was too high to repeat at A2. The allowance of 50 for work-time checks is kept for a category or outbox recheck if the worker's bills or the record raise a question.
